scripts.build: bun --cwd ../../packages/contracts build && bun --cwd ../../packages/sdk generate && vite build && mkdir -p dist/deployments && cp CNAME .nojekyll dist/ && if [ -f ../../packages/contracts/deployments/998.json ]; then cp ../../packages/contracts/deployments/998.json dist/deployments/998.json; else printf '%s\n' '{"status":"pending","reason":"Broadcast artifact not published yet"}' > dist/deployments/998.json; fi
